# Oxide Launcher 1.16.0

## ONIGAMI settings rework

Obsolete VSync and profile controls removed; the writer pins optimized defaults. Direct controls with real backends: program vault (now 64MB default), bilinear upscaler with render scale (50-100%), state coalescing, diagnostics.

## In-game Renderer tab

New Renderer tab appears only when ONIGAMI (Vulkan) is the active renderer, with the same controls plus live internal/output resolution facts. Everything is restart-required.

## Rendering

Draw-call coalescing wired to its toggle, uniform/sRGB resolve caching, diagnostics de-synced from hot paths, vault keys hardened. Frame generation and temporal upscaling intentionally not shipped (missing interfaces documented).
